page: Microsoft Azure NV24s_v2 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for graphics-intensive visualization and virtual workstation workloads within the NVSv2 family. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, the instance provides 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by an Intel processor, alongside an extensive 448.0 GB of system memory, which yields approximately 18.67 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by four NVIDIA M60 GPUs offering a combined total of 32 GB of video memory. In addition to GPU resources and system RAM, the NV24s_v2 features 3,165 GB of local SSD temporary storage and supports Azure Premium Storage for high-throughput persistent disk attachments. Network capabilities exclude complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring auxiliary networking allocation for external routing.

The instance delivers a balanced hardware profile combining substantial multi-GPU capacity, expansive host memory, and large local solid-state storage. These specifications make the NV24s_v2 suitable for remote visualization, computer-aided design (CAD), desktop virtualization, video processing, and memory-intensive simulation pipelines.
